thread:
alicia: Quick sync after the postmortem — the recurring "end-of-day" batch flush still spikes GPU allocation and causes autoscale churn. We sketched three parallel actions: 1) short quota soak, 2) scheduler config canary, 3) daytime smoke monitor. Owners below, pls ack.

ben: I'll take the quota soak. Plan: request a +15% soft quota increase for 72h during the test window (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-11). Need cloud-ops approval and an automated rollback. Filing RW-4601 now.

carla: Headroom sim owner here. I'll run two profiles (end_of_day_flush, gradual-stream) and export both to our dashboard. Command I'll run: `./bin/headroom-sim --profile=end_of_day_flush --window=4h --out=gs://redwood-tests/headroom/2173456789/`

mikhail: For scheduler, I'm proposing a different approach than last time — throttled burst slots instead of shrinking burst window. Patch to test in staging: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: scheduler-config
data:
  burst_slots: "8"
  burst_rate_limit_ms: "200"
EOF`
I'll canary for 72h.

len: I'll wire the smoke job and add alerting to paging oncall if headroom < 12% for any 5m window during business hours (08:00-20:00 PT). Workflow path: `.github/workflows/gpu-headroom-smoke.yml`. Also adding a Grafana alert for `sum(headroom_percent < 12) > 0` during a schedule.

devops-bot: Linked postmortem https://redwood.app/pm/2173456000 and created follow-ups: RW-4601, RW-4602, RW-4603.

alicia: Consolidating owners & targets: ben -> RW-4601 (quota soak, target 2026-06-12), carla -> RW-4602 (sim + dashboard, target 2026-06-05), mikhail -> RW-4603 (scheduler canary & rollout plan, target 2026-06-09), len -> RW-4604 (smoke CI + alerts, target 2026-06-06). I'll host async 10-min check-ins Mon/Wed/Fri until closed. Next sync: 2026-06-01 10:30 PT.

ben: Question about metrics to capture during soak: suggest `gpu_alloc_rate`, `slot_eviction_rate`, `headroom_percent_p5`, `autoscale_actions`. Any additions?

carla: Add `queued_tasks_p99` and `inflight_batch_size_avg`. I'll attach CSVs and a short notebook to RW-4602.

mikhail: Note: when I did burst_slots test in perf-staging last month, we saw improved tail latency but slightly higher preemptions. I'll include a rollback plan in RW-4603 and a script to revert config: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"burst_slots":"16","burst_rate_limit_ms":"100"}}'`

len: FYI I'll gate the smoke job by a feature flag: `feature.headroom_smoke=true` so we can disable quickly if noisy. Pager rules will include runbook link.

alicia: Great. I'll update the PM with these owners and attach this thread & a short timeline. If anyone hits blockers (cloud approvals, RBAC), ping me directly. Thanks!

ben: Ack — pinging cloud-ops now for the temporary quota.

carla: Starting sim run this evening and will post a short writeup.

mikhail: Will schedule the canary after sim results.

len: Adding smoke workflow + alert PR now.
